svg.title: NanoVI pipeline overview
svg.desc: For each sample, full-length 16S Nanopore reads are length-filtered with fastplong, aligned with minimap2 against the database's index, scored with Emu's read score and fitted by Bayesian variational inference with pruning, and written as a species table; the minimap2 index and the identical-16S table are built once into the index cache. The run then writes the consolidated phyloseq tables and, with --report, an HTML and PDF report. Solid green boxes run by default; dashed boxes need the parameter they name. The build-database, collapse-taxonomy and combine-outputs commands are shown below.
svg.text: Species abundances from full-length 16S Nanopore reads: Emu's read score, Bayesian variational inference over a GTDB reference, per-sample and phyloseq tables, and an optional run report
index cache (--index_cache_dir): built once, reused by later runs
